text: {"status":"complete","candidates":[{"dialogueCueIds":["c1","c2","c3","c4"],"contextCueIds":[],"utterances":[{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c1","start":0,"end":9}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":0,"end":15}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":15,"end":23}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":0,"end":3}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":3,"end":17}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c4","start":0,"end":6}]}],"learningValue":"這段對話包含詢問事件是否發生的「有……嗎」句型、轉述他人言論的引用表達、使用「對了」轉換話題的口語銜接，以及詢問語意等實用日常表達。","opportunities":[{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c1"],"description":"「有＋動詞＋嗎」的句型，在台灣華語中常用於確認特定事件或動作是否發生。"},{"category":"chunks","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"description":"「……，是這麼說的」的引用句式，用於向對方轉述第三者的話語內容。"},{"category":"usage","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"description":"話題標記「對了」，用於在對話中切換至新的話題或順帶提及新事項。"},{"category":"chunks","sourceCueIds":["c3"],"description":"「……是什麼意思？」的實用疑問句型，用於詢問詞語、內容或訊息的含意。"}]}]}
